convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom() to load a custom indicator 'ColorZerolagRSIOSMA' and depends on external .mqh library (TradeAlgorithms.mqh) for all trade execution functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, CIsNewBar, GlobalVariableDel_, LoadHistory). These must be reimplemented or ported manually.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator warmup
TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for trade signal timestamp

other_exits: Opposite signal closes existing position: buy signal closes sell positions, sell signal closes buy positions (gated by BuyPosClose/SellPosClose inputs)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum determines sizing: LOT=fixed lot size with MM as lot value; FREEMARGIN=MM fraction of free margin; BALANCE=MM fraction of balance; LOSSFREEMARGIN=MM fraction of free margin minus floating loss; LOSSBALANCE=MM fraction of balance minus floating loss. Implementation is in TradeAlgorithms.mqh.

custom_logic_notes: The ColorZerolagRSIOSMA is a zero-lag composite indicator that computes a weighted sum of 5 smoothed RSI values (Factors: 0.05,0.10,0.16,0.26,0.43) with periods 8,21,34,55,89, then applies double smoothing (smoothing1=15, smoothing2=7). Entry is triggered on bar[1] vs bar[2] crossover of the main line, with bar[0]>bar[1] confirming long and bar[0]<bar[1] confirming short. The SignalBar input (default=1) controls which bar offset is used for signal evaluation; when SignalBar=0, signals are evaluated every tick instead of on new bar. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose booleans independently gate each of the 4 trade actions. LoadHistory() is called each tick to ensure bar data availability. GlobalVariableDel_() cleans up global variables on deinit.
python_conversion_notes: The custom indicator ColorZerolagRSIOSMA must be reimplemented in Python. It is a weighted composite of 5 RSI indicators with periods 8,21,34,55,89 weighted by factors 0.05,0.10,0.16,0.26,0.43, then smoothed by MA(15) and MA(7). The TradeAlgorithms.mqh library must also be reimplemented: BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose functions with MarginMode-based lot sizing (5 modes), CIsNewBar class for new bar detection, GlobalVariableDel_ for cleanup, and LoadHistory for history loading. SL/TP values (1000/2000) are in points; verify whether 5-digit adjustment is needed at runtime since the EA does not auto-adjust. The new-bar guard and SignalBar logic must be carefully replicated: SignalBar=1 means use the just-closed bar for signals; SignalBar=0 switches to tick-level evaluation.
